_finding: The W2-static radar flags tokens by address, and an address rule that misfires accuses the real asset or a fresh Coinbase deploy. A registry address must never be flagged; the full 0xb2+20-zero prefix (~2^88 to forge) is a likely unpublished Coinbase deploy, never an impostor; the prefix signals rest on an observed Coinbase deploy pattern and must switch off, visibly, the moment any registry address breaks it; 3 zeros is chance (1 in 16^5), 4 is the floor; a lookalike is what a wallet shows, per chain; and the radar must report every kind, not only the first.

mutations.name: a registry address is checked for signals
mutations.find: if (recs.some((r) => r.address === addr)) return { listed: true, hits: [], prefix_check }
mutations.expect: FAIL a listed Base address has no hit at all, though it carries the full prefix

mutations.name: the full prefix is reported as an impostor kind
mutations.find: if (k >= FULL_PREFIX_ZEROS) hits.push(hit('unlisted_full_prefix', null, { zeros: k }))
mutations.replace: if (k >= FULL_PREFIX_ZEROS) hits.push(hit('registry_symbol', null, { zeros: k }))
mutations.expect: FAIL the full prefix is never an impostor

mutations.name: the prefix signals ignore the self-check
mutations.expect: FAIL with the self-check off no prefix signal fires, and the caller sees why

mutations.name: the self-check accepts a registry address off the full prefix
mutations.find: const without = recs.filter((r) => vanityZeros(r.address) < FULL_PREFIX_ZEROS).map((r) => r.address)
mutations.replace: const without = recs.filter((r) => vanityZeros(r.address) < VANITY_MIN_ZEROS).map((r) => r.address)
mutations.expect: FAIL one Coinbase address without the full prefix turns them off and says which

mutations.name: the vanity floor drops to 3 zeros
mutations.expect: FAIL 3 zeros is noise, not a signal

mutations.name: the Robinhood lookalike drops the head
mutations.find: return h && h.slice(0, rule.head) === head && h.slice(-rule.tail) === tail
mutations.expect: FAIL Robinhood: the tail alone is not enough

mutations.name: the Base lookalike also demands the head every listed address shares
mutations.expect: FAIL Base: the same last 6 hex without the shared head is caught, and names the listed token

mutations.name: the Base lookalike tail shrinks to 5
mutations.expect: FAIL Base: matching only the last 5 is not a lookalike

mutations.name: the radar stops at the first kind
mutations.expect: FAIL a Base copy carries its symbol, its lookalike tail and its partial prefix at once

mutations.name: the company-name rule is gone
mutations.expect: FAIL the bare company name of a Robinhood token is a strong claim

mutations.name: the corporate ending is not stripped
mutations.find: for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const t = s.replace(CORPORATE_END, '').trim(); if (t === s) break; s = t }
mutations.expect: FAIL the corporate ending and the case do not hide it

mutations.name: a name that contains the company counts as the company
mutations.expect: FAIL a name that only contains the company is not the company

mutations.name: the short-name floor is dropped
mutations.expect: FAIL a name shorter than three letters is a word, not a company
